title: Sync scarcity badge with simulated activity, show named “paid” events, and prefill WhatsApp message for screenshot action

requirements.summary: Make the hero scarcity badge start at “Last 30 slots available” and dynamically decrement based on simulated purchase increments (client-side only).
acceptanceCriteria: On initial page load, the badge renders “Last 30 slots available”.
As the simulated live purchases total increases, the badge’s slots number decreases accordingly (remaining = 30 - simulated increments, clamped at 0).
The slots value does not increase over time.
All badge text remains in English.

file_operations.description: Extend the client-only simulated purchases hook to track the initial total on mount and expose a monotonic simulated increment count (e.g., totalDeltaSinceMount) that can drive the “remaining slots” calculation without introducing any backend calls.

Update the hero scarcity badge to display “Last 30 slots available” on first render and compute remaining slots from the simulated increment count (clamp at 0). Keep all user-facing text in English. Continue using existing shadcn-ui UI primitives already imported on this page (e.g., Button/Dialog/Accordion); verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update the simulated Recent Activity feed to show realistic buyer names with a “paid” action per event (client-only).
acceptanceCriteria: Recent activity rows display a name and the word “paid” (e.g., “Riya paid”).
No recent activity row displays “Someone purchased”.
Simulated activity remains fully client-side (no backend reads/writes introduced).
All user-facing text remains in English.

file_operations.description: Enhance the simulated activity generator so each recent event includes a realistic buyer name and an explicit “paid” action label. Ensure both the initial seeded recent activity and the periodic additions include names, and keep all strings in English.

Replace the hardcoded “Someone purchased” label in Recent Activity rows with the per-event generated buyer name plus the word “paid” (e.g., “Riya paid”). Continue using existing shadcn-ui UI primitives already imported on this page; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: On “Send screenshot” action, open WhatsApp to the support number with a prefilled English payment confirmation message, without breaking the existing Support link.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the “Send screenshot” action opens a https://wa.me/ link to +919622655116 with a prefilled message indicating payment for Canva Pro.
The prefilled message is in English and clearly communicates payment (e.g., “I have paid for Canva Pro”).
This change does not break the existing general WhatsApp “Support” link behavior.

file_operations.description: Add a dedicated WhatsApp message constant for the payment screenshot flow (English), distinct from the existing default support message, to avoid changing current Support link behavior.

Add a separate WhatsApp link generator for the “Send screenshot” flow that targets TECHIFY_CONSTANTS.phone.e164 (+919622655116) and uses the new prefilled payment-confirmation message, while keeping generateWhatsAppLink() behavior unchanged.

Wire the existing “Send screenshot” (or equivalent payment confirmation) UI action to use the new WhatsApp paid-message link (https://wa.me/... with encoded text). Ensure the top navigation Support button continues to use the existing generateWhatsAppLink() behavior. Continue using existing shadcn-ui UI primitives already imported on this page; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
